sources.summary: Danish studio CF Møller has completed the Mind Museum on the island of Funen in Denmark, guided by the "clear spatial structure" of the former psychiatric hospital it occupies. Located in the town of Middelfart, the Mind Museum tells the history of psychiatry in Denmark and the early 19th-century hospital itself.
